title: Gate motif style complexity and quality
summary: Added an explicit 18-cell promotion matrix spanning low, medium, and high complexity, all render-quality tiers, and both pinned Gestalt styles while preserving semantic identity and accepted static-cost realizations. Repaired accumulated closeout contract drift for intentional historical replay, catalog counts, diagnostics, metadata, and dashboard search. Broad validation passed; performance has no regressions, while the known initial-transfer target and a 6x-throttled frame-pacing target remain explicit product debt.
